normalization_rules: Always use the COL. MARK row to lock columns vertically.
Ignore all rows except FOOTING SIZE, DEPTH (d TO D), REINF. //B, REINF. //L, FOOTING MIX.
Extract footing size as width and length from FOOTING SIZE row, format 'width X length'.
Extract depth as the smaller number from DEPTH (d TO D) row.
If a column has only a REFER note and no numeric footing data, return null for size, mix, and reinforcement.
